$comment: Project settings for the technical-team plugin. Only you edit this file: the guard blocks every team agent from writing .claude/. Fill a command list to switch that role from denylist mode to allowlist mode (each entry is a command prefix). Path lists extend the plugin defaults in config/ownership.json; adding docs/** to paths.docs lets the writer use it again instead of .team/docs/. The db section is used when a database specialist (Bash level db-local, e.g. dba) is active: its DB commands must target a host in allowedHosts and a database matching allowedDatabases (glob), given explicitly in the command or through envFile; while it is active, no other role may run db.commands. Leave db.commands empty to use the plugin's default list. skills: per-role lists of skills an agent may load with the Skill tool (project skills by name, plugin skills as <plugin>:<skill>); the lead names the fitting ones in each brief; run-kit is always allowed. externalAgents: non-team agents the lead may call (default ["Explore"]); they always run read-only under the guard, also when you start them yourself. Set [] to turn it off.
